name: Dire Fleet Ravager
oracle_text:
Menace, deathtouch
When this creature enters, each player loses a third of their life, rounded up.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, each player loses a third of their life, rounded up.

needs.what: a value that divides another value by an arbitrary integer with a rounding direction, e.g. {"fraction": {"of": {"life_of": {"binding": "each_player"}}, "divisor": 3, "round": "up"}}, so lose_life inside for_each_player can take ceil(life/3)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only division in value_keys is `half` ({of, round}), which is hard-wired to divide by 2; `times`, `minus`, `sum`, `min` and `max` cannot express an integer division by 3, so a third of a life total rounded up has no spelling
